recap.text: Carl wakes covered in blood and remembers a dream where Shi Maria kills and devours her husband, Hapanzi, a god. Hapanzi appears as a dark-skinned man in a vest with an accent like Asojano's and speaks inside Carl's mind. Hapanzi tells Carl that Shi Maria is trapped in the eye on his chest. Carl can summon her once, and she must then choose to take over his body or expel herself.

beats.headline: A name out of the dream
beats.text: Reconstructed from Crawler Carl's memory as he wakes, covered in blood, on the far side of the map. The dream had a second spider in it: a male, her husband, first a spider and then a man. Shi Maria came in mocking, saw him, then killed him and devoured him while she sobbed. Then he came back. His name, Carl thinks, was Hapanzi, and he had been a god. His words: I have her now, son. She is good and trapped. You can always set her free, if you must. But do not unless all is lost.
beats.gist: Carl wakes covered in blood on the far side of the map and remembers Hapanzi.

beats.headline: Worry not, my children
beats.text: The dream again. A hospital room, Katia at a crib. Shi Maria pushes in, and a second spider follows: Hapanzi, her husband. Nobody says the name, and in that place there are no names over anyone's heads, but in the dream Crawler Carl simply knows it. Worry not, my children, the spider says, and becomes a large, dark-skinned man in simple pants and a vest, with an accent like Asojano's. Carl recognises the voice. It is the one that occasionally speaks inside his mind.
beats.gist: Hapanzi is a god, Shi Maria's husband, and the voice that speaks inside Carl's mind.

beats.headline: The containment in the eye
beats.text: On the screen Shi Maria rampages through the ballroom screaming that she did not kill Hapanzi and never would. At that same moment in the dream, she vanished and Hapanzi reappeared as a spider. He told Crawler Carl she was gone, trapped in his own body, and that Carl now controlled the eye on his chest and the containment she is in. Carl can summon her once. If he does, she chooses: take over his body, or expel herself into her own form. Watching the replay, Carl notes she did not look nearly as trapped as Hapanzi said.
beats.gist: Hapanzi is a god and Shi Maria's husband.

relations.note: He sealed her into the eye
